en.summary: Interactive Brokers is a Nasdaq-listed multi-asset broker with FCA and Central Bank of Ireland regulated entities, no minimum deposit for individual accounts and low published commissions.
pros: Interactive Brokers (U.K.) Limited (FCA 208159) and Interactive Brokers Ireland Limited (CBI C423427) both confirmed on their regulators' registers
No account minimum for individual, joint and trust accounts
Publicly listed on Nasdaq since 2007 with a history dating to 1978
Published commission-based pricing, with forex commissions quoted in basis points of trade size
cons: Has paid numerous regulatory penalties, including a £1.05m FCA fine in 2018 and an $11.8m OFAC settlement in 2025, per Wikipedia
Trader Workstation is feature-heavy and can be complex for beginners
Pricing and products differ between the entities that serve each region
en.body:
## Regulation and safety

Interactive Brokers (U.K.) Limited is on the FCA register under reference 208159, and Interactive Brokers Ireland Limited is on the Central Bank of Ireland register under C423427 (authorised 22 December 2020). In the United States, Interactive Brokers LLC is regulated by the SEC and CFTC and is a FINRA and SIPC member; we did not check those registers. The parent company has been listed on Nasdaq (IBKR) since 2007. Wikipedia records a number of regulatory penalties over the years, including FINRA, FCA, CFTC and OFAC matters.

## Trading conditions

Individual, joint and trust accounts have no minimum deposit on IBKR Pro or IBKR Lite. IBKR's pages quote spot forex commissions in basis points of trade size, for example 0.08 to 0.20 basis points on its fact sheet. We did not find a leverage table, so check the margin rules for your region.

## Platforms

The main platform is Trader Workstation, supported by mobile apps and the IBKR Desktop platform. The broker gives access to stocks, options, futures, forex and, in some regions, crypto.

## Who is it for?

Interactive Brokers suits active and experienced investors who want global market access and commission-based pricing. Beginners may find the platform complex. Leveraged trading carries a high risk of loss.

ja.body:
## 規制と安全性

Interactive Brokers (U.K.) LimitedはFCA登録簿に参照番号208159で、Interactive Brokers Ireland Limitedはアイルランド中央銀行の登録簿にC423427（2020年12月22日認可）で掲載されています。米国ではInteractive Brokers LLCがSEC・CFTCの規制を受け、FINRAおよびSIPCの会員ですが、これらの登録簿は確認していません。親会社は2007年からナスダック（IBKR）に上場しています。Wikipediaには、FINRA、FCA、CFTC、OFACなどによる複数の制裁が記録されています。

## 取引条件

個人・共同・信託口座は、IBKR ProとIBKR Liteのどちらも最低入金額がありません。FXのスポット手数料は取引額に対するベーシスポイントで示されており、ファクトシートでは0.08〜0.20ベーシスポイントとされています。レバレッジ表は確認できなかったため、お住まいの地域の証拠金ルールをご確認ください。

## 取引プラットフォーム

主力はTrader Workstationで、モバイルアプリやIBKR Desktopも用意されています。株式、オプション、先物、FXのほか、地域によっては暗号資産も取引できます。

## どんな人に向いているか

世界の市場にアクセスし、手数料ベースの価格体系を求める積極的な投資家や経験者に向いています。初心者にはプラットフォームが複雑に感じられる場合があります。レバレッジ取引は損失リスクが高い点にご注意ください。
